comments.content: [medium] The console statements added here to verify the provider switch look like temporary debug output — please strip them out before merging so they don't end up logging in production.

[medium] Instead of calling console.log directly for performance monitoring, wrap it in a conditional or route it through a dedicated logging utility. That way production environments won't receive verbose console output that wasn't asked for.
